units.function: Doctor tests distinguishing consistent managed installs, broken marker-without-manifest state and harmless CLI directory residue.
units.dependencyDirection: Builds real temporary install-store artifacts and calls managed-install diagnostics without running services or downloads.
units.keyDataModels: Store marker, install manifest/current link, shim, PATH and update/empty-directory residue.
units.lifecycle: Constructs expected/broken/absent managed-install states and projects pass/fail checks.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 4/4. False-positive avoidance and missing-manifest failure are useful; digest/tamper/mismatch, permissions/links, lock/service/rollback and repair details are absent, and temporary roots leak.
units.designRationale: Report managed installation health without treating update-notice state as a broken installation.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS self-hosted diagnostics need reliable application-version/provenance/service/data-migration health without misleading operators.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the state-aware diagnostic pattern, adding signed artifact digest/SBOM, manifest-current-entrypoint consistency, ownership/link/mode and lock checks, service/database compatibility, previous rollback readiness, stable codes and safe remediation.
units.responsibilityConflict: A healthy install projection still lacks operator approval, exact artifact evidence and migration responsibility records.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 4 passed in combined 9-test run

units.function: Pure tests for deployment bind validation and loopback/tailnet/custom host resolution/presets.
units.dependencyDirection: Calls shared bind validators and CLI preset builder; no socket, proxy or authentication server runs.
units.keyDataModels: Deployment mode/exposure, bind mode, host/custom/tailnet host and server preset.
units.lifecycle: Validates configured mode, resolves runtime host and builds a safe fallback preset.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 5/5. local_trusted loopback and missing-tailnet fallback fail safely; authenticated/managed, LAN/custom, TLS/origin/proxy, adversarial address and runtime-change cases are absent.
units.designRationale: Prevent unauthenticated local-trusted servers from accidentally binding to broader networks while supporting Tailnet access.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS must safely expose managed-cloud, local enterprise and hybrid control/execution planes with explicit network and identity contracts.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the local-trusted invariant and loopback fallback. Validate Tailnet interface/IP ownership, require authenticated mode plus trusted origins/TLS for non-loopback, model proxy trust explicitly and test IPv4/IPv6/LAN/custom/public transitions and interface loss.
units.responsibilityConflict: Network reachability is not authority; every remote human/Connector action still requires IdentityPort authentication, scoped permissions and responsibility evidence.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 5 passed in combined 9-test run
